prefs.anti_aliasing_amd_dx12: Anti-aliasing uses 1× because the startup check drew nothing with multisampling and passed at 1×. You can choose another setting above; restart to apply it if the check passes.
prefs.appearance.colour_vision_help: Changes the colors that carry a meaning: sketch states, axes, bends, analyses and icons.
prefs.browser_body_features_note: Each body in the browser folds open on the timeline features that built it, in timeline order.
prefs.browser_components_open_note: Every component in the browser starts open, as before, instead of closed until you open it.
prefs.browser_eye_left_note: Browser rows show their show/hide eye next to the fold arrow, as before, instead of in a column at the right end of the rows.
prefs.browser_rows_start_closed_note: Placements and folders in the Browser start closed, so a design with many components shows its top-level rows. Each opens with its arrow, Expand All or Find in Browser, which opens just the rows down to its body and closes again the ones the last find opened. A body picked in the 3D view leaves the Browser as it is. When off, folders start open, placements start as Components start open says, and a pick in the 3D view opens the Browser down to its body, as before.
prefs.context_menu_ring: Context menu · hold for the radial menu
prefs.cut_preview_tint_help: A preview fills the material a feature removes, and the shape it replaces, with a red see-through ghost. When off, those fills are fully transparent and only their outlines are drawn.
prefs.dark_parts_shading_help: Shade the view in linear light with a soft sky fill, so dark faces keep a gradient instead of turning black
prefs.design_reopen_views: Reopen a design's views next time it opens
prefs.design_reopen_views_note: A design opens with the views it had when you closed it. Off: it opens with its Model view only.
prefs.design_reuse_views: Reuse a view of the same sheet, sketch or workspace
prefs.design_reuse_views_note: Opening it again shows the view you already have. Off: each opening makes a new view.
prefs.design_sub_tab_render: Open Render and Animate in a sub-tab
prefs.design_sub_tab_render_note: Render and Animate open as their own views of the design. Off: they replace the view you are in.
prefs.design_sub_tab_sheets: Open drawing sheets in a sub-tab
prefs.design_sub_tab_sheets_note: A drawing sheet opens as its own view of the design. Off: it replaces the view you are in.
prefs.design_sub_tab_sketches_note: Editing a sketch opens it as its own view; Finish Sketch returns to the previous one. Off: the sketch is edited in the view you are in.
prefs.design_views_as_tabs_note: Show views as tabs: each view is a tab inside its design's tab, falling back to the switcher when the bar is too narrow. Show one tab with a view switcher: each design keeps a single tab and lists its views in a menu.
prefs.design_views_switcher: Show one tab with a view switcher
prefs.escape_closes_analyses_help: Press Esc with nothing else open to turn off the newest analysis or the section view, as before. Off: they stay on until you close them from their status item, toggle or command.
prefs.extra_navigation: Ctrl+left drag on empty space orbits; hold Space to pan.
prefs.file_operations_wait_note: While a file opens or is inserted, or links are read again, the design waits behind a card with the file's progress and Cancel. Off: the file shows in the operations panel and you can keep working; an insert lands once you finish what you are doing, and a file opened meanwhile goes in a new tab.
prefs.font_fallback: Glyphs the chosen font lacks fall back to the built-in font, so no label shows an empty box.
prefs.font_sample: The quick brown fox · Ø12.50 mm · 45.0° · 0123456789
prefs.font_unreadable: The selected font could not be read.
prefs.graphics_api_help: Choose the graphics API used to open SolidCraft. If the next start cannot open the window, the previous choice is restored.
prefs.graphics_api_override: A launch override is controlling the graphics API. The saved choice will apply when SolidCraft is opened normally.
prefs.graphics_api_restart_note: Applies after a restart. Unsaved designs are handled before closing.
prefs.graphics_card_missing: The saved graphics card is unavailable; Automatic is used.
prefs.graphics_card_restart: Takes effect after restarting SolidCraft. WGPU_ADAPTER_NAME overrides this choice.
prefs.graphics_card_unused: The saved graphics card was not used for this window; the card in use is shown in Help › About and in the status line. Try Automatic, or set WGPU_ADAPTER_NAME to a unique part of the card's name.
prefs.graphics_page.subtitle: Trade speed for smoothness.
prefs.ground_shadow_follows_model_help: Place the shadow below the lowest visible body. When off, raised models keep their shadow on the origin ground plane.
prefs.highlight_moving_joints_help: Dim rigid joints and joints whose parts are fully constrained, so you can see what can still move
prefs.history_bar_groups: Fold the History bar into groups
prefs.history_bar_groups_note: In a long history, a run of one component's features folds into one chip, and feature folders start folded. An inserted STEP assembly goes into a Group folder. Off shows each feature, starts folders open and makes no folder.
prefs.history_folder_kind_icon_note: A History folder whose features are all of one kind shows their icon.
prefs.history_group_joints_note: Two or more joints show as one button with their count, and a click shows each one. Off shows each joint.
prefs.history_in_browser_note: List each component’s features in the Browser and hide the separate History panel.
prefs.history_origin_bodies_note: The History on the left or under the browser starts with the active component's Bodies folder and the Origin, with their eyes and menus as in the browser. The History at the bottom is unchanged.
prefs.history_play_button_note: Puts Play History between Go back one step and Go forward one step in the History controls. You can also right-click the controls to show or hide it.
prefs.history_sketches_note: With Sketches set to Under their feature, the History at the left lists each sketch one level in, under the first feature built from it, whenever it is wide enough for names. The timeline at the bottom always keeps the creation order.
prefs.history_steps_component_note: With a component active or picked, the History controls step through that component's features, as the History at the bottom shows them. Off: they step through every feature of the design. The History on the left or under the browser always steps through every feature.
prefs.home_fit_size_note: How much of the view the model fills when Home, Fit, an opened design or a navigator view change frames it, whether or not the setting below is on. 100 %: fills the view between the panels, the compass and the navigation bar.
prefs.invert_curved_roll_arrows_note: The two curved arrows at the navigator's corner roll the view within the screen plane. On: the clockwise arrow rolls counterclockwise and the counterclockwise arrow rolls clockwise. Off: each arrow rolls the view the way it curls.
prefs.invert_navigator_arrows_note: The arrows around the navigator orbit the camera the way they point, as in Fusion and Inventor: the arrow on the left points right and swings the camera right. Off: an arrow rotates the view toward the side it sits on, so the left arrow swings the camera left. The curved roll arrows are not affected.
prefs.keep_hover_while_navigating: Keep the highlight while the view moves
prefs.keep_hover_while_navigating_note: The face under the pointer keeps its highlight while the view moves under it (off: the highlight goes off while the view moves, as before, #2130)
prefs.keep_work_on_tab_switch: Keep dialogs and tools open when switching designs
prefs.keep_work_on_tab_switch_note: Each design tab keeps its open dialog or tool, with what you picked and typed in it, and its toolbar tab. They are there again when you come back to the design. Off: switching designs cancels them, and Remember each design's toolbar tab decides the toolbar tab.
prefs.layout_note: Floating surfaces have rounded corners and space around them. Compact surfaces sit flush with the window edges.
prefs.layout_page.hover_panel_menus_help: Click a ribbon panel name to open its menu. Hover another panel name to switch. Move outside the ribbon and open menu to close it.
prefs.live_panel_drag_preview_help: Show the panel and the other panels in their proposed positions before you drop it. When off, an outline marks the drop position.
prefs.navigation.radial_help: Hold or flick the right button for a ring of tools.
prefs.navigator_fit: Fit the model after a navigator view change
prefs.navigator_fit_note: A face, corner or arrow of a navigator, or an axis of the gizmo, also looks at the middle of the model from the one distance that fits it from every side (its bounding sphere). Home uses the same zoom and center while this is on, so views chosen after it only turn. Off: the view turns in place, keeping its target and zoom.
prefs.operations_panel_note: Long operations (opening a file, computing a feature, an agent's command) show in the view's bottom-right corner with their progress and a button that cancels them. Off: a Computing notice, as before.
prefs.orbit_snap: Hold Shift during orbit to snap to an axis.
prefs.persistent_ribbon_pressed_help: Highlight ribbon commands while their effects are on. Turn off to keep the previous neutral appearance and command help.
prefs.pinned_constraints_in_grid: Show pinned constraints in the constraint grid
prefs.pinned_constraints_in_grid_note: Constraints you pin to the sketch ribbon's Constrain panel are drawn as small icons in its grid, next to the default ones. Off: each is a full-size button with its name.
prefs.preview_tint_new_faces_help: A preview of a feature that changes a body can draw the surface it adds in the preview color. When off, the body is drawn as itself.
prefs.profile_operations_note: Records how long SMLib calls, kernel operations, features, commands and imports take. Agents read it with diagnostics.profile.
prefs.quick_measure: Quick measurement in the view's corner
prefs.quick_measure_note: The selection's size in the view's bottom right corner: an edge's length, or Ø and R for a round one, a face's area, a point's position, two items' distance and angle, several edges' or faces' total. A click copies it.
prefs.remember_toolbar_tab_note: Each design comes back on the toolbar tab it was last using, such as Surface or Inspect, when you switch back to it. Off: switching designs shows the Model tab.
prefs.render_legacy_image_defaults_help: Keep the previous manual workflow: new setups use CPU raster, CPU ray tracing keeps fixed sampling, and you open rendered results manually. Refit on Render entry, switch shots without restoring their cameras, and use the previous framing and navigation. Disable automatic live image feedback. Saved setups are unchanged.
prefs.render_legacy_memory_admission_hel: Allow native renders within the fixed shared and host memory budgets even when their estimate exceeds available RAM. Device limits and allocation checks still apply.
prefs.render_previous_geometry_budget_he: Restore the previous fixed geometry limit (512 MiB on 64-bit desktop, 128 MiB elsewhere) instead of the device-based budget.
prefs.ribbon_reveal: Show search results in the ribbon
prefs.ribbon_reveal_note: Hovering a result in Search commands shows where the command sits in the ribbon: its tab, its button or its row in a panel's drop-down. A command started from the search blinks there, and a running command from a drop-down marks its panel.
prefs.ribbon_tabs_only_note: The ribbon folds to its tab row. Clicking a tab shows its panels over the view until a command starts or the pointer leaves them. Ribbon Tabs Only in the View tab, or its shortcut, switches this.
prefs.safe_graphics_next_help: Next start only: plain drawing without anti-aliasing, ambient occlusion, blur behind panels or the path tracer, on the graphics API wgpu picks. SolidCraft also starts this way by itself after a start that failed or lost its graphics device.
prefs.scale_note: Also Ctrl + / Ctrl − in the window. Buttons are 28 px at 100%.
prefs.show_design_view_switcher_note: Every design tab shows its view switcher, and editing a sketch or opening Render adds a view of its own. Off: a design tab shows no switcher until you open a second view of the design (Ctrl+T).
prefs.show_selected_hidden_edges_help: Draw a selected body's edges dimmed where the model hides them
prefs.single_surface_analysis_help: When off, surface shading and Continuity can stay on together. Turning this on keeps the last analysis started or changed.
prefs.sketch_tab_always_note: The Sketch tab stays in the ribbon, right after Model, while no sketch is open. Its drawing tools then start a sketch on the selected plane or face, or on the plane you pick next, with the tool ready in it.
prefs.status_bar_note: A thin bar along the window's bottom edge shows what is being edited, the open sketch's state in its color and the design's units; a click on the units changes them. The sketch's state then no longer shows in the view's corner.
prefs.structure.layout_note: Where the parts of the window sit.
prefs.structure.navigation_note: Mouse and trackpad. The 3D mouse has its own page.
prefs.tab_double_click_renames: Double-click a design tab to rename it
prefs.tab_double_click_renames_note: Type the new name, then press Enter or click elsewhere to keep it, or Esc to cancel. Off: a double-click on a tab maximizes the window, as on the empty part of the bar.
prefs.theme_import_hint: Click to choose a theme file, drop one here, or press Ctrl+V (Cmd+V on a Mac) with a theme copied
prefs.trackpad_zoom_modifier: Zoom with two-finger scroll while holding
prefs.trackpad_zoom_modifier.help: Hold only this key to zoom at the pointer with vertical scroll. Off keeps the existing scroll behavior.
prefs.view_confirm_corner_note: While a dialog or a sketch is open, a check and a cross at the top right of the view do what the dialog's OK and Cancel do, or finish and cancel the sketch. The view navigator moves down below them.
prefs.viewport_analysis_status_help: Show active analyses above the viewport and open their legends from each item. Turn off to restore corner legends.
prefs.viewport_material_finish_help: Bodies are lit by a soft studio: metal and glossy appearances reflect it, other bodies get a satin sheen. Off: flat shading in their color, as before
prefs.viewport_section_status_help: Show the section setting in the viewport. Escape and the active ribbon button turn it off. Disable to keep the previous section controls.
prefs.viewport_status_details_help: Edit active analysis and section settings in standard details cards. Disable to restore read-only analysis keys and the Section dialog.
prefs.viewport_status_summary_help: Fold three or more viewport status items into one summary badge. Disable to keep every item in the full row.
prefs.windows_smooth_window_drag: Pause drawing while the window is dragged, so it moves smoothly
prefs.windows_smooth_window_drag_help: While you drag the window by its title bar, SolidCraft draws nothing and the window follows the pointer smoothly. Animations and progress pause until you let go. Off: SolidCraft keeps drawing during the drag, and the window can move unevenly.
prefs.zoom_stop_at_model_tip: The 3D mouse and device app zoom toward the surface in the middle of the view; drag-zoom holds the point where the drag began. Off: zoom can pass through the model. Wheel and pinch use Zoom to the cursor separately
